### Pre-submit Checks

- [x] I have [searched Warp bugs](https://github.com/warpdotdev/warp/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABUG) and there are no duplicates
- [x] I have [searched Warp known issues page](https://docs.warp.dev/help/known-issues) and my issue is not there
- [ ] I have an issue with AI and have included the debugging ID (Optional, but helps expedite the AI quality fix). [Debugging ID instructions](https://docs.warp.dev/agent-platform/agent/ai-faqs#gathering-ai-debugging-id)
- [ ] I have technical issue and have included the logs (optional, but helps expedite the bug fix). [Log instructions](https://docs.warp.dev/support-and-community/troubleshooting-and-support/sending-us-feedback#gathering-warp-logs)

### Describe the bug

`ctrl+y` does "delete all left" on linux and you need to unbind it for paste from internal clipboard to work. 

meaning by default I don't see any easy way to paste from internal clipboard (therefore commands like `ctrl+u` are useless by default)

### To reproduce

1. put some text into the terminal field
2. pres ctrl+y -> it will delete the test to the left)
3. clear the ctrl+y binding
4. put some text into the field again
5. press ctrl+u
6. press ctrl+y -> it will paste from internal buffer (what ctrl+u deleted)

### Expected behavior

At least warn a user about this in some way. 
Or let user change the internal "hard-coded" bindings.

### Screenshots, videos, and logs

_No response_

### Operating system (OS)

Linux

### Operating system and version

6.18.32-1-MANJARO

### Shell Version

zsh 5.9 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu)

### Current Warp version

v0.2026.05.20.09.21.stable_03

### Regression

No, this bug or issue has existed throughout my experience using Warp

### Recent working Warp date

_No response_

### Additional context

The issue seem to be these pieces of code.

fixedbinding for yank: https://github.com/warpdotdev/warp/blob/c37c1cd6ec75726ea297131bab2b2b0b19ecce60/app/src/editor/view/mod.rs#L266

editable binding for delete-all-left: https://github.com/warpdotdev/warp/blob/c37c1cd6ec75726ea297131bab2b2b0b19ecce60/app/src/editor/view/mod.rs#L804

### Does this block you from using Warp daily?

No

### Is this an issue only in Warp?

Yes, I confirmed that this only happens in Warp, not other terminals.
